question.text: In the anatomy of an AIF constitution, what is the CORRECT sequence of foundational documents/parties for an AIF set up as a trust?

answer.text: Settlor executes the Trust Deed with the Trustee; Trustee executes the Investment Management Agreement with the Manager; PPM is then filed with SEBI through a merchant banker
PPM is executed first, then the Trust Deed, then the IMA, then SEBI registration
SEBI registration is obtained first; Trust Deed is executed after SEBI grants registration
Investors subscribe via PPM; thereafter the Trust Deed is executed and the Manager is appointed

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the sequence in which the settlor appoints the trustee by executing the Trust Deed, the trustee then enters into the Investment Management Agreement with the Manager, and once formed the fund applies for SEBI registration through a merchant banker, who files the PPM on which SEBI provides observations rather than approval. The Trap: Options B, C, and D invert this sequence by placing the PPM, SEBI registration, or investor subscription ahead of the Trust Deed and IMA that are required to bring the fund into existence. Note: Per workbook page 124 for the trust-deed and IMA sequence and pages 100 and 235-236 for filing the PPM through a SEBI-registered merchant banker with SEBI providing observations.
